en: Colored vintage postcard showing a grand neo-baroque / eclectic concert and events hall. The facade has ornate sculptures, columns, round windows, and a mansard roof with statues on top. In front there is a small street and railing, with some greenery and adjacent buildings. Red printed caption at the top reads "Budapest" with further text identifying the building as Budai vigadó / Ofner Redoute. Additional small printed text appears at the bottom with a publisher credit and a building-level sign over the ground floor.
